question: Which heads inside the three strongest v15 attention modules carry their behavioral response, and are the heads visible alone or only conditionally within the complete module?
selection_rule: The parent module atlas prospectively chose the three largest attention singleton modules by absolute behavior: attention 8, 9, and 11. No head outcome entered this selection.
population: Exactly the parent's 16 A1 plus 16 A2 v15 rows in frozen order.

interventions.singletons: Complete donor pre-projection response for each of all nine heads at attention 8, 9, and 11, installed alone.
interventions.conditional_leave_one_out: At each selected attention layer, install all eight donor heads except one; compare with that layer's all-nine-head arm.
interventions.controls: Base-head self-patch across all three layers and all-nine-head replay of each parent complete-attention singleton.

predictions.pred_a_authority_population_self_reconst: Parent hashes/order match; base self-patch <=1e-4; each all-nine-head arm replays its parent complete-attention behavior and final response within 1e-5; all metrics finite; exactly 60 forwards execute.
predictions.pred_b_at_least_one_standalone_head_is_m: At least one of 27 singleton heads has absolute behavior projection >=.10 and >=.75 rowwise causal direction.
predictions.pred_c_known_heads_are_enriched: In at least two of the three layers, a prior known head is among the layer's top three by max of absolute standalone behavior and conditional signed necessity.
predictions.pred_d_conditional_head_necessity_is_mat: At least one head changes its all-nine-head layer projection by absolute >=.10 when omitted.
predictions.pred_e_head_support_is_not_singleton_onl: At least two distinct heads have max standalone/conditional absolute contribution >=.08.

terminal_policy.localized_head: A-D pass and the largest standalone head reaches .30 behavior projection.
terminal_policy.distributed_head_set: A-E pass and no standalone head reaches .30.
terminal_policy.known_head_construction_shift: A, B, and D pass but C fails.
terminal_policy.conditional_only_head_set: A, C, and D pass but B fails.
terminal_policy.head_singleton_and_necessity_null: A passes but both B and D fail.

next_branch: Run a frozen greedy combination of material heads across layers 8/9/11 with top MLP modules; a dominant head first receives answer-preserving and unrelated control tests.
